core_result: If a physical scalar pivot leaves rank-two Schur form S=VMV^T with max residual row leverage mu<=1/6, a physical cut exists with leverage below 7/8 and E2>(16/625)det(M)^2. Integrated determinant credit then gives ||p_Q||inf<52.591349 |d|^-1/2 |det M|^-1/4. For exact rank three with pivot leverage ell>1/2 and |d|>=1/2 this is <74.376 regardless of pivot sign.
